name: Relevance
description: The extent to which the response is relevant to the context and the preceding dialogue.

name: Engagement
description: The degree to which the response encourages further conversation and interaction.

name: Coherence
description: The logical flow and consistency of the response within the conversation.

name: Information Content
description: The amount and quality of information provided in the response.

name: Creativity
description: The originality and creativity of the response, including the use of interesting facts or unique perspectives.
